title: Topic 19: Health & Body - Writing
canDoStatement: Say what hurts, name body parts, manage a pharmacy visit

writingTask.writingPrompt:
PROMPT:
  Write the sick-day message as a TEXT to your teacher
  or boss (the same situation as the speaking task -
  now in writing).

Minimum requirements:
  - 5-6 sentences
  - I am sick + one have + symptom sentence
  - one can't sentence
  - one present continuous sentence (what is happening
    at home now)
  - a day (T8): See you on Monday!
minimumRequirements: I am sick + one have + symptom sentence
